The filing includes investment-management reporting and does not prove the bank itself owns the entire stake. Quarter-end disclosures are retrospective and cannot confirm whether holdings survived November’s sell-off. A new securities disclosure puts Wells Fargo among the largest reported holders of BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust, with a position valued at approximately $2.35 billion at the end of September.
